summary: SoundEffects defines the SFX key map (export d) of twelve mp3 files under static/media/sound/: arrow_click, char_click, char_detail_enter, char_list_enter, close_click, common_click, enter_click, home_enter, menu_click, model, news_cate_click and reserve_click. Export A is a SoundEffectPlayer singleton with a pool of 10 <audio> elements primed with a silent WAV data URI; play(src) returns early when SoundControlStore is disabled, pops an element, sets volume 1, loads the src and returns it to the pool on ended or on a play() rejection, and on the first call also plays every pooled element once to unlock audio on touch devices. Note the constructor primes a throwaway element but pushes a fresh document.createElement('audio') into the pool.
